name: Regular San Dieguito Water District - 5:00 p.m.
agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
Regular San Dieguito Water District - 5:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, JANUARY 22, 2025 -
05:00 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
S1.
CALL TO ORDER
San Dieguito Water District Board Members receive an independent stipend of $100 for convening the Water District meetings pursuant to San Dieguito Water District Resolution No. 89-07.
S2.
ROLL CALL
S3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
S4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS – NONE
S5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
(30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Board. Please submit a “WHITE” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. If needed, Oral Communication items will be referred to the General Manager either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
S6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
S7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA
Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
S8.
CONSENT CALENDAR
The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Board. A maximum of two time donations per speaker is allowed (no more than 9 minutes total); the person donating time must be present. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Board Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
8A.
Approval to waive the full reading of the text of all ordinances and resolutions introduced/adopted at this meeting. Ordinances and resolutions shall be introduced/adopted by title only. Contact Person: Board Clerk Hollywood
Approve.
8B.
Approval of the Minutes of the December 18, 2024, Regular Meeting. Contact Person: Board Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2025-01-22 SDWD Item S08B Minutes
8C.
Approval of the Warrants List (Register of Demands). Contact Person: Finance Manager Dinh
Staff recommends that the Board review and approve the warrants.
2025-01-22 SDWD Item S08C SDWD Approval of Warrants List
8D.
Award a Construction Contract for the Encinitas and Cardiff Waterline Looping Project (CW25H). Environmental Considerations: Pursuant to the California Environmental Quality Act, the project is exempt per Section 15302 (c) which exempts the projects characterized as minor alteration to public facilities, involving negligible or no expansion of the existing use. The Encinitas and Cardiff Waterline Looping Project ("Project") is water maintenance project and therefore, meet the criteria for this exemption. Contact Person: Senior Engineer Alex
1) Authorize the General Manager to execute a contract with Rove Engineering, Inc. in substantial form, and any necessary amendments and time extension in consultation with the Agency Attorney, in the amount of $828,893.55 plus an approximate 15 percent construction contingency of $124,300 for a total construction contract not-to-exceed amount of $953,194 including any future contract amendments for the construction of the Encinitas and Cardiff Waterline Looping Project (CW25H); and 2) Adopt Resolution No. 2025-02, titled "A Resolution of the Board of Directors of San Dieguito Water District Amending the Fiscal Year 2024-25 Budget" to amend the FY 2024-25 budget by transferring $953,194 from Project No. CW23C Water Infrastructure Improvements, to fund Project No. CW25H, Encinitas and Cardiff Waterline Looping Project ("Project").
2025-01-22 SDWD Item S08D Award Contractor for CW25H
8E.
Notice of Completion for Emergency Repairs for the 36-inch Transmission Main (CW25G). Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the Board is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" under Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. The action involves an organizational or administrative activity of government that will not result in the direct or indirect physical change in the environment. The action involves acceptance of public water improvements and filing a Notice of Completion. Contact Person: Senior Engineer Alex
1) Accept the public water improvements; and 2) Authorize the General Manager to file a Notice of Completion.
2025-01-22 SDWD Item S08E Notice of Completion CW25G
8F.
Authorization to enter into an agreement with LC Paving and Sealing Inc. to provide General Asphalt Repair Services. Environmental Considerations: The proposed project is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to Section 15301 (c) of the CEQA Guidelines. This section exempts projects characterized as minor alterations to public facilities, involving negligible or no expansion on the existing use. This annual Asphalt repair contract is a water maintenance project and therefore, meets the criteria for this exemption. Contact Person: Operations Manager Gonzalez
1) Authorize the City Manager, in conjunction with the City Attorney, to execute an agreement in substantial form for General Asphalt Repair Services with LC Paving and Sealing Inc in the amount of $256,000 for an initial three-year term, with options to extend upon mutual consent, for two (2) additional one-year terms in an amount not to exceed $80,750 per year for a not-to-exceed five-year term and for a total agreement cost not-to-exceed $418,000.
2025-01-22 SDWD Item S08F Asphalt Contract Award Authorization
8G.
San Dieguito Water District Fiscal Year 2024-25 1st Quarter Budget Report. Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the City Council is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" under Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. The action involves an organizational or administrative activity of government that will not result in the direct or indirect physical change in the environment. Contact Person: Finance Manager Kazungu
1) Receive and file this 1st Quarter Budget Report for the Fiscal Year 2024-25 report reflecting a revised beginning FY2024-25 available net position of $18,807,070 and revised projected ending net position of $13,609,906.
2025-01-22 SDWD Item S08G FY24-25 1st Quarter Budget Report
S9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR
Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
S10.
ACTION ITEMS
To speak on action items, please submit a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Board. A maximum of two time donations per speaker is allowed (no more than 9 minutes total); the person donating time must be present.
10A.
Proposed Amendment to the San Dieguito Water District (SDWD) Administrative Code Article 11 - Conflict of Interest Code. Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the City Council is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" under Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. The action involves an organizational or administrative activity of government that will not result in the direct or indirect physical change in the environment. Contact Person: Board Clerk/City Clerk Hollywood
Adopt Resolution No. 2025-01 titled "A Resolution of the Board of Directors of the San Dieguito Water District Amending Administrative Code Article 11 - Conflict of Interest Code."
2025-01-22 SDWD Item S10A Conflict of Interest Code Amendment
10B.
San Dieguito Water District Annual Financial Report for the Fiscal Year Ended June 30, 2024. Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the Board is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" under Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. The action involves an organizational or administrative activity of government that will not result in the direct or indirect physical change in the environment. Contact Person: Finance Manager Kazungu
1) Receive and file the San Dieguito Water District Annual Financial Report for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2024; and 2) Receive and file this report reflecting the San Dieguito Water District's actual FY 2023-24 available ending net position of $18,807,070.
2025-01-22 SDWD Item S10B FY23-24 Year End Financial Statements and Budget Report
S11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS
To speak on informational items, please submit a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Board. A maximum of two time donations per speaker is allowed (no more than 9 minutes total); the person donating time must be present.
11A.
FY24/25 CIP Update and Execution Rate. Contact Person: Finance Manager Kazungu
Receive the oral report.
11B.
Water Resource and Supply Update. Contact Person: Water Resource Specialist Ogawa
Receive the oral report.
S12.
BOARD MEMBER REPORTS PURSUANT TO AB1234 (GC 53232.3(d)) / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
S13.
GENERAL INFORMATION / STAFF STATUS REPORTS
13A.
General Manager Update/Report
S14.
ADJOURNMENT - THE NEXT REGULAR BOARD MEETING WILL BE HELD ON FEBRUARY 19, 2025
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
